{{Quote|This holoprojection was a gift from Queen Ressa of Drezzi to thank Darth Nyriss for her merciful treatment of the royal family when the Empire conquered their world.|[[Sechel]]|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Drezzi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Revan" /> in the [[Drezzi system/Legends|Drezzi system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="Online" /> that was ruled by a [[King/Legends|monarchy]]. At some point before [[3954 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Conquest of Drezzi|conquered]] Drezzi, and the [[Ressa's husband|husband]] of Drezzi's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Ressa]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]. In gratitude for Nyriss' decision to spare her life and those of her children, Ressa sent a decorative [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] that was displayed in [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|Nyriss's residence]].<ref name="Revan" /> During his career, intelligence operative [[Rane Kovach]] carried out an assignment on Drezzi at the request of [[Theron Shan]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]; Kovach was tasked with infiltrating dissident groups and fomenting revolution while minimizing casualties.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|SIS Asset Brief: Agent Rane Kovach}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Drezzi was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Drezzi [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Drezzi itself, in grid square Q-5.<ref name="Online" />
